name: Chickens vs. Cows
overview: After a failed startup, Max and his friend Pasha suddenly become the owners of a rural farm. Together with them, Nastya gets there, Max's girlfriend, who is not sure that she wants to change the life of the heiress of the factory to a chicken coop. Life on the farm is not easy at all: instead of investments, there are chickens, instead of meetings, there are problems with neighbors and inspections. But gradually, the newly minted farmers learn to cope with difficulties, find new friends and stop being afraid of failures.
